name: capability-reel
about: A 15-25 s launch close (or a short launch film on its own): one line inside a ring of sources, the ring tightening as it becomes a disc that grows into one real record, a statement on a light card that squashes round its line, a ticker through what the product returns, the big claim on the accent in two beats, a graphic transition out of its full stop, and the end card. new-film.sh --template capability-reel lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every reel is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): its cuts and swaps sit on the track's drum onsets and earshot effects mark the state changes; never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 118-134 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track); 118-134 BPM with a punchy kick suits the template's cuts on kicks
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --template capability-reel --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end auto  (its own ending, else a fade: never a cut)

next: capability reel: fill src/reel.ts (the script in plain words: line 1 says what the product is, 2-7 words a line, and the product's own sources, record and capabilities in every [slot]),

the record's real picture (reel.ts record.photo): node scripts/assets.mjs search "<the record's subject>" --kind photo --no-people --fit 4:5, sheet, get '#n' --to public/assets, grade; never a drawn object,
rebuild the product's real record in src/acts/Record.tsx where the kit stands in, then deal its direction:
the sources' real marks: node scripts/logos.mjs get <name> --film . for each source (their slugs in reel.ts logo)
